verification_metadata.description: ECMWF ERA5 10m wind reanalysis live verification artifact, re-confirmed 2026-09-14 with a freshly-created real CDS account/API key (distinct from whatever credentials produced the original 2026-09-06 verification).
verification_metadata.relationship_to_prior_verification: This is a SEPARATE, independently-executed live call made 2026-09-14, not a re-citation of the 2026-09-06 result (see docs/live_era5_verification_detection_36.json, detection #36). It used a different, newly-created CDS account/API key that did not exist on 2026-09-06. The Sentinel-1 scene, acquisition time, and ERA5 grid cell/hour queried are the same real-world values as 2026-09-06 (same bbox/date range was intentionally reused), so identical u10/v10/wind_speed output is EXPECTED: ERA5 is historical reanalysis for a fixed past hour, so a correct real query for that same hour must return the same values regardless of which account or session makes the request. Matching numbers here corroborate, rather than undermine, both results being genuine.

era5_evidence.resolution_note: ERA5 hourly reanalysis on a 0.25° grid (~28 km north-south); not local wind at Sentinel-1 pixel resolution.
